### Bible Pathways 05/28/2002
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-05-or-28-or-2002-1133460.html
Passage: 2 Chronicles 25:15-16
Points:
- Halfhearted obedience and divided loyalties ultimately bring spiritual ruin.
- Amaziah foolishly embraced the defeated gods of Edom instead of honoring the Lord for the military victory.
- Silencing and rejecting God's prophet sealed the king's destruction.
- Overestimating one's importance and harboring pride lead to catastrophic deception.
